goal: Review the source-backed tables, fields, values, dependencies and validation boundaries for the next Foundation setup route.
whyNow: The configuration-package route is realistic for first-time setup, but the concrete U-VAT325-DISC field-selection route is parked and the field map is not complete enough for a read-first or write gate.
businessPurpose: Turn the Foundation setup field map into a consultant-grade configuration-data plan before any Business Central UI route, import, validate, apply or setup write.
expectedOutput: A compact source table and field review result JSON or field-map update.
A nextCase selection: Configuration Worksheet read-first, package-field read-first with new hypothesis, local value-map decision, or parked.
Explicit no-live/no-write boundary and no VAT, posting, master-data or process-readiness claim.
stopConditions: Stop if the review requires opening Business Central or running Playwright.
Stop if a table, field or dependency cannot be source-backed enough for the next route.
Stop if the route repeats any rejected route without a materially new hypothesis.
Stop if the output would unlock import, validate, apply, setup writes or master data writes without a separate gate.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use if the table/field review defines a different read-first UI surface and exact evidence target.
Use if tables and fields are known but planned values, owners, validation and dependencies need a local decision before UI.
Use if Foundation setup should remain parked and project work should continue with training/handbook or Master Data boundaries.
